name: ProfessorX
source:
The mysterious head mod of the MM server. Humorous and flirty, he comes off rather personable despite the number of secrets he keeps. He plays his cards close to the chest and works himself to the bone for his vision.

[From [url=https://heartmoorstudios.itch.io/mythic-meetup]itch.io[/url]]
